purpose: State implementation requested by the user. Original masters become first variants; IDs and existing instances are preserved.

arguments.name: Button
arguments.description: The single mechanism for triggering an action. Weight (primary → destructive) signals how much attention the action deserves. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Input
arguments.description: Text entry and search. Search fields in persistent chrome show a keyboard shortcut hint; form fields inside a flow do not. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Nav item
arguments.description: Primary navigation inside a workspace. Icon and label always travel together — never icon-only in this context. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: List row
arguments.description: Any scannable list — inbox, transactions, notifications — where someone compares many items at a glance. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Table
arguments.description: For rows with three or more comparable attributes — use the List row component instead when a row only really has a title and one piece of metadata. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Dropdown
arguments.description: Covers two Base UI primitives: a Menu for a set of actions attached to a trigger, and a Select for choosing one value from a fixed list. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Card
arguments.description: A bordered container for related content. Three uses: a plain grouping surface, a clickable summary, and a single-stat headline. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Tabs
arguments.description: Two designs: primary tabs switch between full page-level views; secondary tabs switch a scoped region without changing the page. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Switch
arguments.description: An immediate, self-contained on/off setting — it takes effect the moment it's toggled, with no separate save step. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Checkbox & radio
arguments.description: Checkbox for zero-to-many selections; radio for exactly one choice from a small, fully visible set of options. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Accordion
arguments.description: Progressive disclosure for secondary content the person doesn't need immediately — never the primary content on a screen. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Amount input
arguments.description: Money entry, specifically — distinct from the plain text Input because precision, asset, and available balance all have to be visible at once. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Command palette
arguments.description: What the ⌘K hint on the persistent Search field actually opens — search and act on anything in the product without leaving the keyboard. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Pagination
arguments.description: Pairs with the Table component once a list is long enough to split across pages. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Toast
arguments.description: A brief, self-dismissing confirmation for something that already happened — a payout landing, an invoice getting paid. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

arguments.name: Alert / banner
arguments.description: Page-level, persistent messaging — the pattern already used for the notes throughout this document. Different from a Toast because it doesn't go away on its own. Visual states are Figma variants; runtime interaction remains the responsibility of the app.

notes: No hidden/closed blank components are created. Visibility is handled by the consuming flow.
Hover, pressed, focus, disabled and loading are visual Figma variants; this does not install app behavior or wire prototype transitions.
Toast and Alert use semantic Tone properties rather than misleading hover/disabled states.
Each set is laid out with non-overlapping state previews.
The default master is promoted into the first variant. Unrequested prior states are retained on future updates.
State sets occupy a separate board area to the right of the seven unchanged static masters.
